'''Richta Blade''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Richta Blade serves as a crew-skill trainer for [[Synthweaver|synthweaving]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] side at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] within the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.
